## What's new

### Remote server: watch and answer your agents from your phone
Optional and off by default: Settings > Remote server. ymux connects out to a
relay you run yourself,
[yMux-Server](https://github.com/YoungMins/yMux-Server) (Docker, default port
11020, behind your own HTTPS domain). The phone uses a web app served by that
server, which can be added to the home screen.

- **Set up**: deploy yMux-Server, enter its address and setup token in
  Settings > Remote server, switch the connection on, click "Pair a phone" and
  scan the QR code. The phone shows a 6-digit number; type it into ymux.
- **On the phone**: see every agent pane and its status across workspaces,
  read a pane's screen, answer a menu or permission question, send Stop
  (Escape), and send a prompt (queued automatically while the agent is busy).
- **Notifications** when an agent is waiting or has finished. They carry only
  the workspace and pane names, never screen text or prompts.
- **Several computers, one server**: connect each ymux to the same server and
  pair the phone with each of them.
- **Access levels per phone**: view only, view and answer, or view, answer and
  prompt.

### Security
- Off by default. The computer alone decides whether a command runs; the
  server only relays.
- Everything between the phone and ymux is end-to-end encrypted, so the relay
  cannot read or change it.
- Pairing needs the number typed on the computer.
- There is no remote command for raw keys, new panes or files.
- Every remote action is written to a local audit log (it holds no prompt or
  screen text).
- Limits: the relay serves the phone's web app, so host it yourself on a
  machine you trust and keep it updated. Scan a pairing QR only from your own
  screen.

### Upgrade notes
- Nothing changes unless you switch the remote server on. Keep ymux and
  yMux-Server on the same minor version.
- No new keyboard shortcuts.
